name: yarner-client
description: The yarner web client: build and play interactive adventure stories.

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -j 4 --release -p yarner-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir ../yarner-wasm/pkg ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/yarner_wasm.wasm
